summary: Daily usage rerate after account timezone change causing credit gap
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports a gap in applied daily credits for March 8-9 after we rolled a change to account-local daily rollups. NimbleDocs observes a ~12% of expected daily credits missing on the invoice and credits appear to have been shifted to March 7.

Impact: Customer-facing billing discrepancy affecting month-to-date credits and forecast; customer has paused a scheduled audit until resolved. This is a single-customer (dedicated) issue but may affect other customers who have non-UTC account timezones.

Environment: nimbledocs-prod (dedicated), account timezone set to America/New_York, rollup pipeline running in us-east-1.

Observed timeline:
- 2026-03-07 23:55 EDT: NimbleDocs batch jobs spike (normal).
- 2026-03-08 00:05 EDT: Rerate/rollup job kicked off by scheduler change deployed 2026-03-06.
- 2026-03-09 03:12 EDT: Customer reported missing credits via in-app billing link.

Initial hypothesis: A recent change to the daily rollup window to honor account-local timezones caused a rerate job to reassign usage boundaries; a bug in the rerate window calculation double-applied an offset during DST/zone transition which moved a fraction of credits back one day instead of keeping them on the recorded day.

Requested customer action: Provide any billing screenshots showing the missing credits (they already attached sample invoice lines) and confirm whether account timezone was recently modified on their side (they confirmed no).

Steps to reproduce: See steps_to_reproduce field for operational reproduction checklist.
steps_to_reproduce: Set up a dedicated account with timezone America/New_York
Generate token usage that crosses midnight local time (e.g., job from 23:50 to 00:10 local)
Trigger a manual rerate of the daily rollup for the affected date range using /internal/usage/rerate endpoint
Observe that a subset of small-duration streaming sessions are re-assigned to the previous day after rerate
Inspect credits allocation in the billing rollup and compare pre/post rerate lines

2026-03-08T00:05:13Z billing-processor WARN credits-move detected 0.12% of daily tokens reassigned from 2026-03-08 to 2026-03-07
Relevant invoice lines provided by customer: INV-20260309-NIMBLE-003 (attached in ticket)
Stack trace excerpt (usage-aggregator): timezone_offset_calculate() -> apply_local_rollup() + rerate_window_adjust()
investigation_notes: Support triage: Verified invoice lines and compared raw token counts in usage store. Discrepancy corresponds to small, short streaming sessions (~0.4s median) around midnight local time.
Reproduced locally with test account: rerate job moved sessions when account tz != UTC and DST flag handling path exercised.

Hypothesis refined: when rerate job uses account-local offset, a recent refactor introduced use of cron-derived offset and then applied explicit DST correction, resulting in a cumulative extra hour shift for a small class of sessions.

We observed the rerate job reprocessing historical blobs and writing new rollup records without marking old ones as superseded in billing ledger; this can leave invoices showing both original and rerated lines until consolidation runs.

Potential blast radius: limited to dedicated and private accounts with non-UTC timezone settings and to dates near timezone transitions or where rerate jobs were executed during a window overlapping deployment (2026-03-06 -> 2026-03-08).

2026-03-10 10:04 James Mallory (NimbleDocs): Confirmed no change. We use America/New_York for billing and noticed the credit drop on March 9 invoice. We need an ETA — this is impacting month-end close.

2026-03-11 14:33 Marco Chen (SRE): Reproduced locally. Created a test job that replicates the one-hour double-offset. Filed INT-4201 for a fix to rerate window calc. Will test patch on staging tomorrow.

2026-03-11 15:05 Aisha Kumar (Support): Shared a temporary mitigation: schedule a consolidation job to re-run ledger consolidation; this will surface correct single-line credits in the billing view pending a permanent fix. Asked customer if they'd like us to run consolidation on their tenant (requires maintenance window).
2026-03-12 08:22 James Mallory (NimbleDocs): Please run consolidation. We can take a 10-minute maintenance window tonight after 22:00 EDT.

2026-03-12 12:10 Marco Chen (SRE): Scheduled and executed consolidation at 2026-03-12 02:15 UTC (22:15 EDT). Preliminary results: invoice preview shows credits reassigned back to the expected days; further validation ongoing. Keeping ticket open until verification complete.
resolution_notes: Workaround: Performed ledger consolidation for nimbledocs tenant on 2026-03-12 02:15 UTC which restored credits to expected invoice lines. Root cause: rerate job double-applied DST/local offset for a subset of short streaming sessions when account timezone != UTC. Fix: INT-4201 patch to rerate-window calculation landed in staging; plan to roll to prod behind feature flag after additional tests. Follow-ups: (1) Run integrity check for other affected tenants in the same timezone cohort; (2) Add safeties to prevent rerate from writing duplicate ledger lines; (3) Add automated alert for credit-moves >0.1% of daily tokens. Customer requested confirmation email after customer invoice preview is validated.
